server.testText: This build is connected to a test server, not the Maintafox server:

serverUnreachable.title: Server unreachable
serverUnreachable.text: Check the phone's connection (Wi-Fi or mobile data), then try again.

serverError.title: The server is not responding properly
serverError.text: Try again in a few minutes. If it continues, tell your administrator.

permissionDenied.title: Not allowed
permissionDenied.text: Your account is not allowed to do this. Ask your administrator.

accessScope.title: No access
accessScope.text: This account has no access to this plant on this phone. Tell your administrator.

passwordChange.title: Password change needed
passwordChange.text: Change your password on a Maintafox PC, then sign in again.

licenseNotFound.title: Unknown key
licenseNotFound.text: This licence key does not exist. Check it and try again.

licenseRevoked.title: Licence revoked
licenseRevoked.text: Ask your administrator for a new key.

licenseExpired.title: Licence expired
licenseExpired.text: The licence must be renewed before this phone can be activated.

licenseDenied.title: Licence refused
licenseDenied.text: The licence does not allow this phone. Tell your administrator.

deviceRevoked.title: Phone removed
deviceRevoked.text: This phone was removed from the licence. Ask your administrator to allow it again.

deviceLimit.title: No phone slot left
deviceLimit.text: All phones allowed by the licence are already activated. Ask your administrator to free one.

mobileNotLicensed.title: Phones not included
mobileNotLicensed.text: Your plant's licence does not include the field app. Tell your administrator.

updateRequired.title: Update needed
updateRequired.text: Install the latest version of the app, then try again.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.text: This item no longer exists on this phone. Synchronise, then try again.

validation.title: Data refused
validation.text: Check what you entered, then try again.

databaseKey.title: Phone data unreadable
databaseKey.text: This phone's encrypted data cannot be opened. Contact your administrator.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.text: Try again. If it continues, tell your administrator.

startup.title: Starting
startup.subtitle: Getting the app ready…
startup.databaseKeyBody: This phone's encrypted data cannot be opened. Contact your administrator.
startup.rollbackBody: Version {{to}} could not update the data. Reinstall version {{from}}.

security.title: Screen lock required
security.body: A phone screen lock (PIN, pattern or fingerprint) is required. Turn it on in the phone settings, then check again.

activation.title: Join your plant
activation.joinOnly: Enter the licence key your administrator gave you. The phone joins an existing plant.
activation.keyHint: The phone never creates an organisation or the first administrator: that is done on a Maintafox PC.
activation.confirmText: Check this is your plant before you continue.
activation.notInitialized: This organisation is not set up yet. Set it up on a Maintafox PC first.
activation.noAdminBody: The plant has no administrator yet. It must be created on a Maintafox PC.
activation.plantJoiningHint: Keep the app open. It usually takes less than a minute.
activation.connectionNeeded: Connect the phone to the internet to receive the plant's data.
activation.slow: The server is taking a while to answer…

signin.title: Sign in
signin.subtitle: Sign in with your Maintafox account.
signin.passwordChangeBody: Your password must be changed on a Maintafox PC before you use the phone.

wo.title: My work orders
wo.empty: No open work order is assigned to you.
wo.executionSoonTitle: Execution on the phone: next step
wo.executionSoon: Starting, timing, entering results and closing the work order from the phone come with field version 1. Until then, use a Maintafox PC.

exec.safetyConfirm: I have read the safety instructions
exec.safetyConfirmHint: Required before starting. Your confirmation is recorded.
exec.failureHint: Lists from the plant's reference data.
exec.handoverPlaceholder: What the next shift needs to know

scan.title: Scan
scan.hint: Place the equipment's QR code in the frame

di.title: Report a fault
di.subtitle: Intervention request (DI)
di.subject: Subject
di.noOrgNode: This equipment has no site: the request cannot be created.
di.listEmpty: Empty list in the reference data: {{field}}. Tell your administrator.

blockers.not_licensed: The licence does not allow synchronisation. Tell your administrator.
blockers.not_activated: This phone is not activated yet.
blockers.activation_refused: This phone's activation was refused. Tell your administrator.
blockers.tenant_config_mismatch: This phone is linked to another plant. Tell your administrator.
blockers.not_configured: Synchronisation is not set up yet.
blockers.other: Synchronisation is stopped. Tell your administrator.

settings.title: Settings
settings.signOutText: The plant's data stays on the phone. You will need to enter your password again.
